hypothesis: Human-confirmed receipt timing plus identity-coherent relative velocity learns control evidence absent from source-boundary supervision; dense non-event negatives prevent conditional-event inference.
exposure: Previously consumed development matches, not blind confirmation. WPY training not scored for selection.
features: 48 scalar features: team nearest-player distance, identity-coherent relative velocity norm/radial motion/player speed, collective player speed/count/availability; at -.4,0,+.4s. No events/status/GT input at inference; no absolute direction dependence. Existing geometric observations, NOT new sensor data.
supervision: Human receive times and recovery/keeper controls, corroborated by same team source HAD for next.4s; +/- .2s positives; exclude +/-1s event/transition ambiguity; remaining all-timeline5Hz none negatives. Same-feature source HA transition and shuffled positive-team supervision controls.
training: 3 StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1 balanced max_iter500 lbfgs, team-swap augmented. Natural and existing label-independent long-occlusion training views. Unknown class is not Dead.
inference: Predict3classes on EVERY frame; average mirrored outputs. Human potential = pH+.5*pUnknown. Equal .5 mixture with frozen C1 Home. Same fixed.3s binary decoder in frozen HC Dead segments for all arms. No new D changes. No geometry proposals required.
gate: Both evaluation natural matches improve full HC_M3 spellF1,mean>=.02,net true matches positive atIoU.5,short recall no decrease>.02,real beats same-decoder/source/shuffle/time controls. Otherwise NO_GO; any success still needs untouched cross-provider full labels.
stop: One configuration,3fits,no test-driven tuning; preserve failures and production HC/M3
